result.line: MimSwap Klines-fork pools (factory 0x8D0Cd3eEf1794F59F2B3a664Ef07fCAD401FEc73, impl 0x2958db359d22411cdf9825f8b27f17350a6fc6bb): no claim/reward/harvest/collect function; stranger-callable sync()/correctRState() pay 0, ratioSync/rescue/setPaused revert 0x08fc08f9 (operator only); swaps charge the caller 5 bp LP fee to protocol-owned LPs + maintainer fee; 7 d = 98 swaps / 333.85 USD gross on 2 of 20 pools (23,192.79 USD held) = ~0.17 USD LP fees, gas 0.012-0.036 USD, 91 of 98 swaps by 2 bots.
